company.name: Esaal
company.shortDescription: Esaal offers physical health, mental health, and nutrition consultations with health professionals.
company.description: Esaal is an online platform that enables users to book consultations and communicate with professionals through digital channels. The service supports remote interactions across areas such as healthcare, business, and personal advisory services. It provides scheduling, virtual meeting, and communication tools designed to facilitate online consultations. The platform primarily serves users in the Middle East and Arabic-speaking markets.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,700,000, or 58.62% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,678,285 to $10,335,884, a 2.21x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 50 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
